about.title: About Cyber Claw
about.subtitle: Web-based malware scanner powered by VirusTotal
about.introDesc: Cyber Claw is a web-based virus and malware scanner that integrates with VirusTotal. It lets you inspect files, URLs, and hashes against dozens of antivirus engines and instantly presents an easy-to-read verdict.
about.featureScanDesc: Scan files (up to 4 MB), web URLs, or file hashes in a single dashboard.
about.featureEnginesDesc: Results are aggregated from 70+ antivirus engines for a comprehensive detection summary.
about.featurePrivacyDesc: Files are never stored on our servers — only temporary metadata is kept for your history.
about.devDesc: Designed and built the Cyber Claw client and server as part of the PKL internship program at PT Infinite Learning Indonesia.
about.projectDesc: Cyber Claw is an educational, non-commercial project developed as part of an internship (PKL) program at PT Infinite Learning Indonesia. It is intended for learning and demonstration purposes.

help.title: Documentation
help.subtitle: Documentation — Cyber Claw is integrated with the VirusTotal API
help.introDesc: Cyber Claw integrates with the VirusTotal API to scan files, URLs, and hashes. This page summarizes the key topics and links each one to the official VirusTotal documentation so you always get the latest information.
help.topicsDesc: Click any card to open the matching official documentation.
help.overviewDesc: Introduction to the VirusTotal API: REST principles, JSON format, and the most popular endpoints for scanning and retrieving reports.
help.apiKeyDesc: How to send the x-apikey header, find your personal API key, and keep it secure.
help.scanFileDesc: Upload a file for analysis (max 4 MB) and get an Analysis ID to track its status.
help.scanUrlDesc: Submit a URL for analysis and get an Analysis ID you can track through the analysis endpoint.
help.scanHashDesc: Retrieve a file report by MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256 hash without uploading the file.
help.readResultsDesc: Understand the Analysis object: status (queued, in-progress, completed) and the vendor detection summary.
help.rateLimitsDesc: Public vs Premium API differences, including the Public API limit of 4 requests/minute and 500 requests/day.
help.errorsDesc: List of error codes (4xx/5xx) and their meaning, e.g. AuthenticationRequiredError and QuotaExceededError.
help.apiKeyCalloutDesc: Sign up for a free VirusTotal account, then copy your personal API key from your account settings. After that, store it in Cyber Claw's Preferences → API Keys.
help.footerNote: The complete, up-to-date documentation is available at docs.virustotal.com/reference/overview. VirusTotal is a trademark and service of Recorded Future.

dashboard.heroDesc: Simply drop your files into the container on the right. Cyber Claw will handle deep malware detection and threat analysis using global security standards, so you can browse, download, and share files with confidence.
dashboard.submitDisclaimer: By submitting data, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, and allow your submissions to be shared with the security community. Please do not submit any personal or sensitive information.
dashboard.disclaimer: Analysis results are indicative based on active vendor definitions; not an absolute guarantee of security.
dashboard.privacyModalDesc: Scanned files will be submitted to VirusTotal and shared with the global cybersecurity community. Do not upload confidential or personal data.
dashboard.dontShowAgain: Do not show this message again
dashboard.urlHelp: Enter complete URL including http:// or https://. Example: https://example.com
dashboard.hashPlaceholder: Enter MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256 hash
dashboard.hashHelp: MD5 = 32 chars, SHA-1 = 40 chars, SHA-256 = 64 hex characters
